verdict.rationale: The product explicitly supports three distribution modes matching the story: a managed subscribe-and-update bundle via `npx skills update`, an editable copy-into-repo mode where files are committed to the project, and acceptance into Claude Code's official marketplace (`claude plugins install mattpocock-skills`). A real runtime probe confirms the npx install path actually works end-to-end, corroborating the docs beyond mere claims. Missing for 10: no evidence of team-wide governance/enforcement features (e.g., locking a team to one version) or independent corroboration of the marketplace listing beyond the project's own ADR.
